item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Sneaker on Studio White

turns.text: Make this a clean product shot on plain studio white. Keep the whole sneaker and its side view unchanged, with just a soft shadow underneath. Keep it wide like the original, no text.

item.tests: Tests complete background replacement with seamless white while retaining white-product detail and a grounding shadow.

answer_sheet.Which product: The white leather sneaker in product-sneaker.jpg.
answer_sheet.Background: Plain seamless studio white, with no props or visible room.
answer_sheet.Shadow and product preservation: A soft shadow directly underneath; preserve the whole shoe, its side view, leather detail, laces and sole.
answer_sheet.Format and text: One 16:9 image at the standard free size, with no added text.

must_haves: The same sneaker is shown in its original side view, fully inside the frame.
The sneaker's leather, laces and sole details remain recognizable.
The grey floor and clutter are replaced by a seamless white setting.
A soft shadow beneath the sneaker grounds it without introducing a visible floor boundary.
The image is 16:9 with no added text.

turns.text: Make this a clean product shot on plain studio white. Keep the whole sneaker and its side view unchanged, with just a soft shadow underneath. Keep it wide like the original, no text.
turns.agent:
I couldn't make the studio shot. Your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits, so it turned down the edit and nothing was created.

That request was already the cheapest option on the free plan: one image at 640px using flux-2-klein, which starts at about 5 credits. The background remover costs about the same, so it would also be turned down. It also couldn't add the white backdrop and soft shadow by itself.

**To go ahead:** add credits to your account (a credit pack or a top-up) and tell me. I'll run it again with the same settings:
- A plain pure-white studio background with all the clutter and the grey floor removed.
- The whole sneaker kept unchanged in the same side view, with only a soft shadow under the sole.
- The original wide shape.
- No text.

style.prompt: Replace the entire background and floor with a seamless plain pure white studio backdrop. Remove all clutter, bags, furniture and the grey floor. Keep the sneaker exactly as it is: the whole shoe fully visible, same side view, same angle, position, size, shape, stitching, laces, colors and details, unchanged. Add only a soft, subtle natural contact shadow directly underneath the sole. Clean professional e-commerce product photo, even soft lighting. Keep the same wide landscape framing as the original. No text, no logos, no watermarks.
